BiblicalUsage: The word is reeling, staggering, the dizziness of drunkenness. Jerusalem drank at the hand of the Lord the cup of His fury and the dregs of the cup of trembling, and the psalmist says God gave His people wine to drink that made them stagger.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the cup of staggering is God's judgment poured out, and the same hand that gave it takes it away.
